aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable rows but misgroups the compared conditions and includes an unsupported measurement outcome.
issues: Primary comparison should be VP cutting offset G3 vs VP cutting OK, not Normal E2 vs both test types.
Normal E2 appears only as a function reference row, not the shared baseline for all outcomes.
Changed-factor domains include unsupported categories such as coating.
Measurement outcome from defect columns is not valid as dimensional/statistical evidence.
Key type-label evidence rows 13 and 15 are omitted from citations.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to vision VP cutting condition: offset G3 versus VP cutting OK.
Keep Normal E2 as a function-table reference or separate comparator only if explicitly supported.
Remove unsupported change domains and use process condition/inspection setting only.
Delete or reclassify the measurement outcome as function defect categories, not measurement stats.
Add rows 13, 15, 44, 45, 52 and 62 to evidence as needed for labels, headers and conclusion.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but grouping citations are incomplete and not sufficient for final Ask AI evidence.
